notes.headline: Guangdong opens by beating everybody
notes.dek: The champs posted the best line in all 12 matchups in Week 1. LeBrown James was close behind, and Sam Presti and Filed for Bankruptcy tied 4–4–1.
notes.byline: Written from Fantrax league data for Week 1 (Oct 20–25).

storylines.title: The champs pick up where they left off
storylines.body: Guangdong led the league in points (849), rebounds (297), assists (177) and threes (93) and would have beaten all 11 teams. Luka Doncic had 103 points and 24 assists. The one blemish: 139 turnovers, the most in the league, 21 of them from Luka.

storylines.title: LeBrown James wins the Maxey show
storylines.body: Tyrese Maxey had a league-high 115 points and Ty Jerome added 104 on 56% shooting, and LeBrown James beat Competing God 7–2. Their week would have beaten 10 of 11 teams.

storylines.title: Blocktopus loses 5–4 and adds Sabonis
storylines.body: Blocktopus won FG%, steals, blocks (a league-high 44) and turnovers, but Guangdong won the scoring categories. On Sunday they sent Moussa Cisse and their 2027 1st and 2nd to Zach Babies for Domantas Sabonis, which should help on the boards.

storylines.title: A tie to start the season
storylines.body: Sam Presti and Filed for Bankruptcy split the categories 4–4, then tied blocks at 21 each. Bankruptcy shot 49.5%, the league's best, while Presti won FT%, assists and steals.

storylines.title: Rookie watch
storylines.body: Caleb Wilson (Presti) led all rookies with 67 points, 24 rebounds and 6 steals. Cameron Boozer had 35 rebounds, but also the week's worst shooting among high-volume scorers: 14 of 49.

matchups.rufupenmmqqv88in_070oazg4mqqv88in: Projects 7–2 Guangdong. Competing God's best chances are FG% and turnovers, the one category the champs lost badly in Week 1.
matchups.b33iacngmqqv88in_ctvglb6gmqqv88in: Projects 5–4 eweiss35. Blocktopus is favored in rebounds, steals, blocks and turnovers, so it may come down to whether Sabonis lifts the scoring categories.
matchups.cipchrpimqqv88in_n3z2eshxmqqv88in: Projects 8–1 Shanghai. Zach Babies scored 292 points in Week 1, the fewest in the league, and now has fewer veterans after the Sabonis trade.
matchups.saydaqzgmqqv88in_auysoygrmqqv88in: Projects 6–3 Filed for Bankruptcy. West Palm Salon's edge is free throws, assists and turnovers.
matchups.xoe774vlmqqv88in_mizl2op8mqqv88im: Projects 5–4 Team OD, the closest call of the week. K-Ville is favored in threes, FT%, points and assists.
matchups.d91prsm4mqqv88in_ygisq4rlmqqv88in: Projects 8–1 LeBrown James. Presti's best chance is steals, where they led the league with 52 in Week 1.

bruno.auysoygrmqqv88in: Slipped to second by a hair. Flagg, Peterson and Wagler all turn 23 in the title season, with four picks still to come. No roster has more young talent peaking at once.
bruno.d91prsm4mqqv88in: Presti drafted a whole backcourt: Harper, Demin, Acuff, Mikel Brown, Caleb Wilson and Fears, plus Jalen Johnson in his prime. If two of the kids become stars, they can pass both teams above them.
bruno.070oazg4mqqv88in: New No. 1. The champs barely fade: Doncic is 31 in 2030–31 and Holmgren and Barnes are still in their primes. The only team in the top two both today and in the title season.
bruno.b33iacngmqqv88in: Still fourth. Wembanyama projects as the league's most valuable player in 2030–31, and Sabonis helps right now, but trading the 2027 1st and 2nd leaves no picks to build depth around him.
bruno.saydaqzgmqqv88in: Down to sixth, but eight picks is the second-most in the league. VJ Edgecombe, LaMelo Ball and Brandon Miller are the core; a good 2027 draft could push them back up.
bruno.mizl2op8mqqv88im: Shai keeps them dangerous, but he's 32 in the title season and Adebayo 33. Third today, eighth by 2030–31, so the window is now.
bruno.ygisq4rlmqqv88in: Up to fifth. Maxey and Clingan keep the line steady, and three picks give them more ways to add a star than most teams around them.
bruno.xoe774vlmqqv88in: Built for right now: first today, seventh by 2030–31, when Jokic is 35 and Murray and Bane are past 30.
bruno.cipchrpimqqv88in: Amen Thompson and Dyson Daniels are a strong defensive base, but Curry, Jaylen Brown, Irving and Holiday will be on the back nine by 2030.
bruno.rufupenmmqqv88in: Cameron Boozer is a real centerpiece, but Anthony Davis is 37 in the title season. Fourth today, eleventh by 2030–31; they need a second young star.
bruno.ctvglb6gmqqv88in: Giannis and Porter make them a threat today, but both are past 30 in 2030–31 and they hold no picks. Tenth on the long view.
bruno.n3z2eshxmqqv88in: Ten picks now, including two more from the Sabonis trade, but Nate Ament is the only young player in their core. Expect this ranking to climb once those picks turn into players.
